description: Brasov Industrial Portfolio is a Romanian company specialized in the provision of production and logistics facilities, with a focus on high-tech solutions for economic development and logistics efficiency in the Brasov region. The company serves industries such as automotive, construction, consumer goods, and e-commerce, and operates facilities that include airport logistics and smart city logistics hubs. Its operations are supported by technologies such as automatic plate scanning, automatic weigh-in stations, and RFID systems, with a primary emphasis on last-mile logistics and urban warehousing.

METRO Cash & Carry Romania SRL, known as METRO România, is a Romanian wholesale company that operates in the hospitality, restaurant, and catering sector, as well as serving independent retailers. The company supplies food and non-food products, including fresh and frozen produce, meat, dairy, beverages, and professional equipment and furniture. METRO România also provides digital services for retail operations and manages a central logistics platform for distribution and supply chain management. The company is involved in sustainability initiatives and is certified as a Top Employer in Romania and Europe.
core_offerings: Proprietary Brand Product Development and Distribution

description: OSCAR DOWNSTREAM S.R.L is a Romanian private company engaged in the distribution and trading of oil and gas products, including diesel, gasoline, bitumen, and lubricants. The company operates a nationwide network of gas stations, manages in-house fuelling stations, and provides fuel card solutions for fleet and business clients. OSCAR also offers en-gross fuel solutions and manages a logistics infrastructure supported by tankers and storage facilities. The company serves sectors such as transport, agriculture, construction, and industry, and is part of the Alfa Group.

The company oversees both public and private railway networks, providing access to terminals and stations, and offers services such as ticket sales and information. It also manages railway modernization and infrastructure development projects, including European Union-funded initiatives, and is involved in public procurement processes. The company is a member of international railway organizations and is certified for its operations.

description: Fildas Trading SRL is a Romanian company engaged in the import, distribution, and retail of nutritional supplements, pharmaceuticals, dermatological cosmetics, and technical-medical products. The company operates as a wholesaler, distributor, and retailer, supplying pharmaceutical products to retail locations and pharmacies through a network of logistics centers and regional warehouses. Fildas Trading also manages a pharmacy network under the Catena brand and maintains a transport fleet for national distribution. The company is certified and serves clients across Romania.

C.N. Poșta Română S.A. is a Romanian joint stock company engaged in providing universal postal services, including letter mail, parcel delivery, money transfer, and advertising services. The company also operates as a provider of business solutions, customs clearance, and electronic signature services. In addition to its core postal operations, Poșta Română is involved in public sector activities such as the sale of real estate and energy compensation services. The company serves the entire Romanian territory and is active in the postal organization and logistics sectors.

description: VALTEC Premium Lubricants SRL, DBA Valtec, is a Romanian company specialized in the supply and distribution of lubricants and related products for the industrial and automotive sectors. The company serves clients across industries such as automotive, transport, construction, agriculture, building maintenance, health, and hospitality in Central and Eastern Europe. In addition to its core activities, Valtec operates as a distributor of hygiene and cleaning supplies, personal protective equipment, and safety products, and offers a private brand, Valtec Safety, for personal protective equipment. The company maintains a supply chain and logistics network to support its operations.

description: STILL Material Handling Romania SRL is a Romanian company engaged in the development, production, and distribution of intralogistics equipment and systems. The company supplies and rents forklifts, transport and towing equipment, and internal logistics solutions, including static and dynamic racking, mobile racking, and automated guided vehicles. STILL also provides fleet management services, digital service management tools, and repair and maintenance solutions. The company serves a global market and operates production sites in Germany, Italy, China, France, and Brazil.
core_offerings: Static and Dynamic Racking Systems Integration

description: AQUA INVEST, known as AQUA CENTER, is a Romanian company engaged in the production and export of composite pipe products, including composite pipes, PVC pipes, and PVC fittings, serving the construction, water supply, and drainage sectors. The company operates a logistics and production center and exports its products to over 40 countries, with a significant market presence in China. AQUA CENTER is ISO certified and is involved in the development of Yongtong Industrial Park and the expansion of production capacity.

Rompetrol is a Romanian energy company engaged in refining, petrochemicals, and retail operations, as well as providing well services in the upstream sector. The company supplies fuels and related products to both individual and business clients in Romania, Moldova, Bulgaria, Georgia, and Kazakhstan, and is involved in the development of energy projects through its participation in the Kazakh-Romanian Energy Investment Fund. Rompetrol also manages a supply chain and logistics network to support its operations and is committed to sustainability and decarbonization initiatives.

C.N. Administratia Porturilor Maritime S.A. Constanta, known as Portul Constanta, is a Romanian public company that operates as a maritime and river port authority, managing and overseeing the ports of Constanta, Midia, Mangalia, and Tomis. The company provides port management, cargo handling, and related services, including dry bulk, container, general cargo, liquid bulk, and roll-on/roll-off operations. It also functions as a transit hub for agricultural products and serves as a free port. The company is part of the Romanian maritime port sector and is supported by European Union funds for the naval sector.
core_offerings: Dry Bulk Cargo Handling and Transshipment
Cargo Ticket Booking and Reservation Services
Liquid Bulk Cargo Handling and Transshipment
Regulatory Compliance and Institutional Integrity Services

description: TIMAC AGRO S.R.L. is a French agricultural company engaged in the development, production, and distribution of plant nutrition, animal nutrition, and biostimulation solutions for farmers and agricultural producers. The company operates globally, with a presence in Europe, America, Asia, and Africa, and collaborates with scientific institutes and universities to advance its research and development activities. TIMAC AGRO also engages in sustainable agriculture practices and environmental responsibility.

Bunge Romania SRL, DBA Bunge Romania, is a Romanian company specialized in the wholesale supply of agricultural commodities, including grains, oilseeds, and biodiesel, serving the food and beverage sector. The company operates multiple facilities across Romania, providing crushing, refining, bottling, and biodiesel production services. Bunge Romania is ISO certified and holds additional certifications such as FSCC, KOSHER, EFISC, ISCC EU, and ISCC PLUS.

S.N.G.N. Romgaz S.A. is a Romanian public company engaged in the exploration, production, storage, and distribution of natural gas. The company also operates as an electricity producer and supplier, and provides technological transportation services. Romgaz is involved in geological exploration, well interventions, workovers, and special operations, and is a member of the European gas industry. The company is publicly traded on the Bucharest Stock Exchange and is majority owned by the Romanian State.

OMV PETROM Marketing SRL is a Romanian company engaged in the natural gas and oil industry, operating in the Exploration & Production, Refining & Marketing, and Chemicals sectors. The company provides products and services such as gasoline, diesel, aviation fuel, bitumen, and chemical products, and manages fuel stations and gas storage facilities across multiple European countries. OMV also offers e-mobility solutions and is involved in sustainability initiatives, including circular economy solutions and carbon emission reduction.
core_offerings: Oil and Natural Gas Exploration and Production
